caption:
Biggest minus biggest won't give you the biggest difference.

To make 3x − 2y as big as possible, push x to its max and y to its min, since subtracting a negative adds. Plugging in 7 and 2 gives only 17.

Comment the greatest value you can make.
tiktok_caption: Greatest value of 3x − 2y? Biggest minus biggest is the trap.

youtube.title: Greatest Value of 3x − 2y From Two Ranges (SAT)
youtube.description: Pair the maximum of one variable with the minimum of the other to maximize a difference. SAT-style practice question (original).
